cache_provenance.lookup: native Lake traces/artifact cache; no per-dependency prior-hit claim

cgroup_cpu_attribution: whole observed cgroup; may include unrelated activity
compiler_scope_policy: workspace descriptors or verified live supervisor; each compiler inherits its elastic claim
concurrency_basis: compiler wrapper start/finish intervals, each holding one slot

resource_accounting.global: sampled cgroup memory/CPU, startup and growth credits; no peak-envelope reservation
resource_accounting.isolation: cooperative sampled admission; no per-run kernel memory isolation or OOM guarantee
resource_accounting.run: frontend/job/thread ceilings, sampled owned-tree RSS cutoff, own-tree pressure retreat

summary.cgroup_memory_attribution: whole observed cgroup; an OOM event alone does not identify its victim
summary.frontend_observation: wrapper starts only; arbitrary phase tools may bypass local compiler caps
